summary.text: Adam Bernbaum is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 24-Position 1 since January 13, 2025, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bernbaum's career experience includes working with the Council for Court Excellence, as a rural organizer, as a campaign field organizer for U.S. Representative Derek Kilmer, and as a legislative assistant to state Senator Kevin Van De Wege, according to Ballotpedia.
